newsitem.title: USA: Ralcorp co-chief executive Pearce resigns.
newsitem.headline: Ralcorp co-chief executive Pearce resigns.

text.p: Ralcorp Holdings Inc said its co-chief executive officer and president, Richard Pearce, has resigned effective on Friday to pursue other interests.
Joe Micheletto, co-chief executive and chief financial officer, will assume the title of chief executive and president of the company, in addition to his present responsibilities, Ralcorp said.
Pearce also resigned from the board. The company said his board position will not be filled at this time.
Pearce said that since the company sold its ski resort and branded cereal businesses, two chief executives are not needed.

"(T)he remaining company will be substantially smaller in size and will no longer require the services of two chief executive officers," Pearce said in a statement. "As a result, I believe it is time for me to explore other opportunities."
